new.text: In one US campus study, students sent a check-in note to a classmate. On a 1 to 7 scale, senders guessed about 5.6. The classmates gave about 6.2.

quote: Experiment 2, advance online version pp. 7-8: students wrote a note "to check in and say hello" to a classmate they had "not interacted (either virtually or in-person) in a while"; "Initiators (M = 5.57, SD = 1.35) significantly underestimated how much their reach-outs were appreciated compared to how much responders (M = 6.17, SD = 1.24) appreciated them" (1 = not at all, 7 = a great extent; 54 dyads).
